configure_logging_server: configure the logging settings of an SGLang server via HTTP POST
enable_request_logging: enable request logging on the SGLang server with configurable log level
configure_request_dump_folder: set the dump folder path for captured SGLang server requests
set_request_dump_threshold: configure the threshold count for dumping server requests
run_configure_logging_cli: run the SGLang configure_logging CLI module with custom URL and logging options
